meta.subject: hardware: checkpoint handling duplicate TLB insertions

en.summary: The commit fixes overlapping TLB lookup and control operations by serializing them onto a single request virtual-page path and by suppressing lookup during insert or invalidate cycles.
why_it_counts: The commit message identifies duplicate TLB insertion handling.
The patch changes the TLB RTL and both front-end drivers that issue TLB commands.
The fix affects translation correctness and stale-entry handling, which are central DUT behaviors.
evidence: dcache_tag_stage.sv now disables tlb_lookup_en during DTLB update or invalidate operations.
ifetch_tag_stage.sv suppresses fetch during ITLB update or invalidate cycles and routes either PC or control address through one request_vpage_idx input.
tlb.sv removes separate lookup, update, and invalidate page-index inputs, uses request_vpage_idx for all commands, and asserts $onehot0({lookup_en, update_en, invalidate_en}).

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A TLB that serves both translation lookups and software-driven insert or invalidate operations must serialize the virtual-page reference used by those commands. If a lookup is allowed to run in the same cycle as an update or invalidate, especially with separate address inputs or partially shared set logic, the structure can read one page while modifying another. That can leave duplicate entries, fail to invalidate the intended translation, or return a translation for the wrong page.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: TLB command arbitration and request-page serialization
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A lookup overlaps in time with a TLB insert or invalidate operation from the same pipeline stage or a coupled control path.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Allow lookup, update, and invalidate to operate concurrently or to use separate unsynchronized virtual-page inputs in the same cycle.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: remove command serialization and restore separate address paths
portability_notes: This maps best to TLBs that share sets, ways, or read ports between translation and control operations.
The key bug is not just concurrent enable bits but concurrent use of different page references on partially shared state.
If the target design already has a single command bus, the analogous mutation is to relax the mutual-exclusion check and let normal lookup proceed during control commands.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the TLB command interface for lookup, insert, and invalidate.
Break any mutual-exclusion rule that guarantees only one of those commands is active in a cycle.
Restore or add separate virtual-page inputs so control commands and lookups can reference different pages concurrently.
Allow the fetch or data-side pipeline to keep asserting normal TLB lookup during insert or invalidate instructions.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: TLB request_vpage_idx path and lookup suppression during update or invalidate
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix routes lookup, update, and invalidate through one request_vpage_idx path, suppresses lookup during TLB control operations in the tag stages, and asserts that only one command class is active at a time.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore separate lookup_vpage_idx, update_vpage_idx, and invalidate_vpage_idx style handling in tlb.sv, re-enable tlb_lookup_en during control operations in dcache_tag_stage.sv and ifetch_tag_stage.sv, and remove the onehot command assertion.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The TLB can create duplicate entries, fail to invalidate the targeted entry, or perform translation using the wrong virtual page when a control operation overlaps a lookup.
evidence_for_injection: The patch changes both the TLB itself and the two pipeline stages that drive it, which matches a real interface-level correctness bug.
The new request_vpage_idx input replaces all separate page-index inputs in tlb.sv.
The added onehot assertion makes the intended serialization explicit.
notes: This bug pattern is portable to both ITLBs and DTLBs.
The most important reusable insight is to serialize the page identity, not merely to serialize the enables.

zh.summary: 该提交通过把 TLB lookup 与控制操作串行化到同一条虚页请求路径上，并在插入或失效周期禁止 lookup，修复了重叠 TLB 操作的问题。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确指出是在处理重复 TLB 插入问题。
补丁同时修改了 TLB RTL 以及两个发出 TLB 命令的前端驱动阶段。
修复影响的是地址翻译正确性和陈旧项失效行为，属于核心 DUT 行为。
evidence: dcache_tag_stage.sv 现在会在 DTLB update 或 invalidate 操作期间关闭 tlb_lookup_en。
ifetch_tag_stage.sv 在 ITLB update 或 invalidate 周期抑制取指，并把 PC 或控制地址都通过同一个 request_vpage_idx 输入送入 TLB。
tlb.sv 删除了独立的 lookup、update、invalidate 虚页输入，统一使用 request_vpage_idx，并加入 $onehot0({lookup_en, update_en, invalidate_en}) 断言。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 既要处理普通地址翻译 lookup，又要处理软件驱动的插入或失效操作的 TLB，必须把这些命令使用的虚页引用串行化。如果允许 lookup 与 update 或 invalidate 在同一个周期重叠，尤其是它们还通过不同地址输入或部分共享的 set 逻辑访问 TLB，就可能出现读取一个虚页、却修改另一个虚页的情况。结果可能是产生重复项、失效错误目标，或者返回了错误页的翻译结果。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: TLB 命令仲裁与请求页串行化
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: lookup 与来自同一流水级或耦合控制路径的 TLB 插入或失效操作在时间上重叠。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 允许 lookup、update、invalidate 并发执行，或者允许它们在同一周期使用彼此不同且不同步的虚页输入。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: remove command serialization and restore separate address paths
portability_notes: 该故障最适合映射到 lookup 与控制操作共享 set、way 或读端口的 TLB 上。
核心问题不只是并发 enable 位，而是在部分共享状态上同时使用不同的页引用。
如果目标设计本来就只有一条命令总线，对应的注入方式是放宽互斥检查，让普通 lookup 在控制命令期间继续进行。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 TLB 中 lookup、insert 和 invalidate 的命令接口。
破坏任何保证这些命令在同一周期只能有一种生效的互斥规则。
恢复或新增独立的虚页输入，使控制命令与 lookup 可以在同一周期引用不同的页。
允许取指侧或数据侧流水线在 insert 或 invalidate 指令期间继续发起普通 TLB lookup。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: TLB 的 request_vpage_idx 路径以及 update 或 invalidate 期间对 lookup 的抑制
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 lookup、update、invalidate 都路由到同一条 request_vpage_idx 路径，在 tag stage 中于 TLB 控制操作期间关闭 lookup，并断言同一周期只能有一种命令类型处于活动状态。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 tlb.sv 中恢复 lookup_vpage_idx、update_vpage_idx、invalidate_vpage_idx 这类独立输入处理；在 dcache_tag_stage.sv 和 ifetch_tag_stage.sv 中重新允许控制操作期间的 lookup；并删除 onehot 命令断言。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 当控制操作与 lookup 重叠时，TLB 可能产生重复项、失效错误目标，或者使用错误虚页完成翻译。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁同时改动了 TLB 本体和驱动它的两个流水级，符合真实的接口级正确性错误特征。
tlb.sv 中新的 request_vpage_idx 取代了所有原先分离的页索引输入。
新增的一热断言把预期的串行化约束明确写了出来。
notes: 这一故障模式既可迁移到 ITLB，也可迁移到 DTLB。
最重要的可复用结论是要串行化页身份本身，而不仅仅是命令使能位。
